row:
Welcome to my channel! I’m passionate about fostering and advocating for senior dogs, sharing heartwarming stories, helpful tips, and the joys of giving these incredible pups a second chance. 

From behind-the-scenes looks at fostering life to inspiring adoption journeys, I create content that celebrates the resilience and love of senior dogs. You’ll also find videos about dog care, my personal pack of senior Chihuahuas, and glimpses into life as a content creator and small business owner. 

Whether you’re here for laughs, learning, or love, this channel is all about showing that senior dogs deserve the spotlight. Subscribe to join the journey!
